sentences.en: I hear he traveled by bicycle from Hokkaido to Kyushu.
sentences.zh: 我听说他骑自行车从北海道骑行到了九州。

sentences.en: The little girl is not capable of riding a bicycle.
sentences.zh: 小女孩还不会骑自行车。

sentences.en: Yesterday I met two Americans who are bicycling through Japan.
sentences.zh: 昨天我在日本遇到了两个正在骑行的美国人。
